notes: C5 asks specifically for complementary XAS data to support the polarization attribution of the intensity suppression toward M; P18 challenges the entangled polarization/momentum variation across theta_in and asks for polarization- or geometry-separated RIXS data (e.g. sigma-polarized light), so it is scored as partly. C7 asks about the ~1 eV branch in Fig. 3d, whether it is pi-pi intraband, and whether its absence is a polarization effect; P5 and P14 discuss the 0.5-1.5 eV pi-pi intraband weight in chi0 and how the orbital/polarization weighting shifts weight away from that branch in Fig. 4a vs 4b/3d, so C7 is scored as partly. C10 asks to qualify the EELS/IXS invisibility claim for low-density/semimetals; P7 and P6 ask to qualify the same claim with respect to the small-q regime below the plasmon cutoff and multiband screening, so C10 is scored as partly.
